subs.group: Missa Quandiu vivam soli Deo serviam
subs.note: Jean Hérissant. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Hérissant, Missa Quandiu vivam soli Deo serviam)
items.desc: Jean Hérissant, Missa Quandiu vivam soli Deo serviam, Kyrie, before 1558. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
